$Comment: Names the ziggfreedcommon:track_pick reading for requirement lines. Param is a track id and a pick or option id joined by a slash (Your_Swords/Your_Edge); the reading is how many times the player took it on that track: every level whose choice took that option, every take of a pick bought outright, every level of a choice pick made. Write Min 39 to ask for 39 Edge picks (a line rank). It counts what lives: a pick in a stance (its Stance group) counts only while its face is held in one of the stance's slots, every other pick exactly as taken; ziggfreedcommon:track_pick_owned counts what is owned whether held or not. A pick or option that names itself words its own lock lines ('Requires Edge picks 39'). It changes only through the player's own picks, their undo, a respec or a prestige, a face held or released, or a track, pick or stance reload (Volatility Player).
